cost_equation.break_even: smallest positive integer N where candidate_at_N < fixed_at_N

pass_condition: Candidate calibration cost is strictly lower than fixed calibration cost at external_q25_primary_N_star.
scientific_boundary: This is a calibration-only economic stress test.
It does not use validation-v6 graphs or outcomes.
The cost units are abstract search-accounting units, not wall time or dollars.
Stable Diffusion request reuse is not automatically a Foundry artifact-reuse distribution.
A pass does not complete P2, establish runtime novelty, or authorize a prospective trial.
